title: Family and children — core set
titleVi: Gia đình và trẻ em — bộ từ cốt lõi
description: Bộ từ về cách nuôi dạy con, các kiểu gia đình và áp lực lên cha mẹ hiện đại. Nhóm này giúp bạn viết về gia đình một cách cụ thể thay vì lặp lại "family is important".
ieltsUse: Dùng cho Task 2 các đề về nuôi dạy con, vai trò của gia đình, nghỉ thai sản, khoảng cách thế hệ và ảnh hưởng của bạn bè tới trẻ.

words.vi: sự nuôi dạy, cách giáo dục trong gia đình
words.def: the way a child is raised by parents or carers
words.example: A stable upbringing is one of the strongest predictors of academic success.

words.def: the activity of raising children
words.example: Modern parenting places enormous pressure on working mothers in particular.

words.def: a brother or sister
words.example: Children with siblings develop negotiation skills earlier than only children.

words.vi: đại gia đình (nhiều thế hệ, họ hàng)
words.def: a family including grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins
words.example: In many Asian societies the extended family still shares childcare duties.

words.vi: gia đình hạt nhân (bố mẹ và con)
words.def: a household of two parents and their children
words.example: The nuclear family has replaced the multi-generational household in many cities.

words.def: a household headed by one parent
words.example: A single-parent family often struggles with childcare costs and inflexible jobs.

words.def: differences in values between young and old people
words.example: Technology has widened the generation gap within many households.

words.def: the rules parents use to control children's behaviour
words.example: Excessive parental discipline can damage a child's confidence rather than improve behaviour.

words.def: to care for and encourage the growth of someone
words.example: Schools should nurture curiosity rather than reward passive obedience.

words.def: the period between childhood and adulthood
words.example: During adolescence, peer approval often matters more than parental advice.

words.def: a child aged about one to three
words.example: Screen time for toddlers should be limited, according to paediatric guidance.

words.def: the care of children while parents work
words.example: Affordable childcare enables more mothers to return to full-time work.

words.def: time off work for a mother around the birth of a child
words.example: Generous maternity leave is associated with lower infant mortality.

words.def: time off work for a father after a child is born
words.example: Countries offering paternity leave report a more equal division of household work.

words.vi: người trụ cột kinh tế trong gia đình
words.def: the person who earns most of a family's income
words.example: When the breadwinner loses a job, the whole household is affected.

words.def: routine tasks such as cleaning and cooking
words.example: Sharing household chores fairly reduces conflict between partners.

words.def: the duty of children to respect and care for parents
words.example: Filial piety remains central to family life in much of East Asia.

words.def: a person whose behaviour others copy
words.example: Parents are the most influential role models for young children.

words.def: influence from friends to behave in a particular way
words.example: Peer pressure pushes many teenagers towards smoking and alcohol.

words.def: too anxious to let a child become independent
words.example: Overprotective parents may unintentionally prevent children from learning resilience.

words.def: allowing too much freedom, especially in parenting
words.example: Permissive parenting is often blamed for poor self-discipline in teenagers.

words.def: the development of a close emotional relationship
words.example: Skin-to-skin contact encourages bonding between parents and newborn babies.

words.def: the children of a person or animal
words.example: Better education allows parents to invest more in each of their offspring.

words.vi: quan hệ huyết thống, họ hàng
words.def: the relationship between members of a family
words.example: Kinship ties remain strong even among families separated by migration.

words.vi: hộ gia đình có hai nguồn thu nhập
words.def: a household where both partners work for pay
words.example: Dual-income households can afford better housing but have far less time at home.
